consequences: HB196 gives ten 132 studs, 1/4-28 x 1-7/16 inch, with 7/16 inch between nut and surface. HB199 gives ten washers111, ten nuts101, ten cotters106 and one mounting gasket8348.
Mounting requires 40 hardware occurrences plus one gasket, outside the provisional internal pump inventory.

The printed 11.1125 mm nut-to-case surface span exceeds the current estimated 6 mm flange + 0.4 mm gasket + 1 mm washer stack (7.4 mm) by 3.7125 mm. Resolve the stack before installing the source-length stud.
A 9.7125 mm flange would satisfy that stack under the same gasket/washer estimates; this is a derived candidate, not accepted geometry.
HB196 has two oil-pump-to-manifold tubes8174 plus suction tube12039, extension8040, gasket158 and two plug161. Reconcile the existing case galleries with these identities.
